headline: Who is Faye? The hero of God of War Laufey
title: Who Is Faye | God of War Laufey Hero Explained | Kratos Wife
video_script: Who is Faye? Laufey, known as Faye, is the hero of the next God of War. She was a giant, a Jotnar warrior known as the Golden Hand and once called Laufey the Just. She was Kratos' wife and the mother of Atreus, and her death is what starts God of War twenty eighteen. Deborah Ann Woll, who voiced her in Ragnarok, returns to play her. Did you expect a Faye game? Comment below!
